name: Hawaii
standard: Section 508 + WCAG 2.1 A and AA (or later version adopted by the Access Board or DOJ)

laws.summary: ETS, with DCAB, must publish EIT accessibility standards that all state entities must follow.
Bars disability discrimination by state agencies and state-funded programs; complaints go to the Hawaii Civil Rights Commission.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: Hawaii Electronic Information Technology Disability Access Standards v1.1 (effective 2025-01-01)

applies_to: All state entities: executive, legislative and judicial branches, public bodies, public K-12 and postsecondary schools, and the University of Hawaii; contractors providing public services must comply too.

deadlines.what: About 6 months after publication (2025-01-22): agencies must revise procurement and development rules to include the standards
Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Revise procurement and development rules within 6 months of publication or amendment
Put standards compliance language in all EIT contracts
ETS reviews the standards every three years
Recommended: VPATs in procurement, monitoring, periodic reviews and training
mobile: implied — scope covers software applications and cites the DOJ web and mobile app rule, but does not name mobile apps as covered EIT.
procurement: Standards compliance language is required in all EIT contracts; VPATs are recommended.
enforcement: Complaints under HRS § 368-1.5 go to the Hawaii Civil Rights Commission; DCAB advises on the standards.
notes: The standards document still lists the old federal date of 2026-04-24, which has been superseded. The HRS section where Act 172 is codified was not confirmed (capitol.hawaii.gov blocked the fetch, and the Act PDF is a scan). The HRS 368-1.5 complaint path comes from search results. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
